channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Team USA Gets A Reality Check In Olympic Men's Hockey
item.description: Team USA's dominant start to the Olympics in Game 1 turned into a closer-than-expected victory over Denmark in Game 2. Their chances of clinching the top overall seed took a hit, but they dealt with some adversity effectively.

item.title: NHL Players Who Could Join Triple Gold Club With Olympic Gold Medal
item.description: There could be new members of the Triple Gold Club following the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan. Canada, Czechia, Finland and Sweden all have NHL players that are just one gold medal away from joining the exclusive club.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Former Blue Jackets D-Man Dean Kukan Snipes An OT-Winner For Switzerland
item.description: Dean Kukan, who scored five career NHL goals as a defenseman for the Columbus Blue Jackets, went coast-to-coast and sniped a bar-down shot in overtime to win the game and the second spot in Group A for Switzerland against Czechia.

item.title: Olympic Women's Hockey: Looking Ahead As Canada's Poulin Returns, Quarterfinal Upsets
item.description: The semifinals are upon us in the Olympic women's hockey tournament. Canada's Marie-Philip Poulin returned to Canada's roster and helped them defeat Germany. They'll face Switzerland on Monday, while USA takes on Sweden, eyeing its third Olympic gold medal.

item.title: Predators' Stamkos Could Be a Fit For Kings Following Fiala Injury
item.description: Los Angeles Kings star left winger Kevin Fiala suffered a season-ending injury at the Olympics. Could Nashville Predators star right winger Steven Stamkos be the Kings' major offensive acquisition before the NHL's trade deadline?

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Canada's Wilson Gets A Game Misconduct For Fighting Against France
item.description: Team Canada's Tom Wilson was ejected at the end of the contest against France for fighting Pierre Crinon, who had previously elbowed Nathan MacKinnon in the face. "I appreciate Tom sticking up for me. He's a great teammate," said MacKinnon.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Canada Set For Quarterfinal, Dismantling France In Final Group Game
item.description: Team Canada wraps up the group phase with a crushing 10-2 win over France, setting itself up for their quarterfinal outing on Wednesday.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Czechia Hasn't Performed As Medal Contenders Like Many Expected
item.description: Despite pre-tournament hype that pegged them as a dark-horse pick to do damage at the 2026 Olympics, Czechia has faltered in virtually every game and now faces a tougher path toward Olympic gold. Can they rebound and make it to the podium?

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Qualifying Round Matchups Are Set
item.description: The group phase of the 2026 Olympic men's hockey tournament is complete, and the qualifying round matchups are set. With that, the path to the quarterfinal is also in sight as the potential matchups are revealed for the round following the qualifiers.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show At The Games: Previewing The Qualifying Round
item.description: From Milan, Michael Traikos helps break down the final day of round-robin men's hockey action with Andrew McInnis and Michael Augello.
